title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Six-piece handicap

explain.ja: 図1-1は6枚落ちの基本図で、上手は飛車・角・桂・香を落としています。8枚落ちと比べると上手に銀が2枚加わっているので、簡単には敵陣を突破できません。
explain.en: Figure 1-1 is the basic position of the six-piece handicap game, where White has removed the rook, bishop, knights and lances. Compared with the eight-piece game White has two more silvers, so breaking through is not easy.

section.ja: 六枚落ちの基本図と下手の狙い
section.en: Basic diagram of the six-piece handicap and the stronger side's aims

explain.ja: 6枚落ちでは、下手は9筋や1筋を狙って攻めるのが良いとされます。今回は角を6六に上げて9筋に狙いをつけます。角は9三の地点に利いています。上手には桂や香といった端を守る駒がなく、そこが弱点になるのです。
explain.en: In the six-piece game it is considered good for Black to attack on the 9th or 1st file. Here Black raises the bishop to 6六 to aim at the 9th file, and the bishop bears on 9三. White has no knights or lances to guard the edge, which makes it a weak point.

section.ja: 六枚落ちの基本図と下手の狙い
section.en: Basic diagram of the six-piece handicap and the stronger side's aims

title.ja: 図2-1 9筋の歩を伸ばしていく

explain.ja: 下手は▲9六歩から▲9五歩と9筋の歩を伸ばして端攻めを目指します。次に▲9四歩、△同歩、▲同香として9筋を攻める狙いです。ただしいきなり攻める前に指しておきたい手があるので、上手の形をよく見て次の手を考えましょう。
explain.en: Black extends the 9th-file pawn with ▲9六歩 and ▲9五歩, aiming for an edge attack. The plan is ▲9四歩, △同歩, ▲同香 to attack along the 9th file. But there is a move to play before attacking, so look at White's setup and think about the next move.

section.ja: 9筋の歩を伸ばしていき端攻めを狙う
section.en: Extending the 9th-file pawn to aim for an edge attack

title.ja: 図2-2 角の逃げ道を作る
title.en: Figure 2-2: Create an escape route for the bishop

explain.ja: 図2-1で上手は、△6四歩として角を攻める手を狙っています。それに▲8八角などと逃げると角が端に利かなくなり、端攻めが失敗します。そこで▲5六歩と突いておき、△6四歩には▲5七角と引けるようにします。▲5六歩を突かなかった場合の失敗例は、補足で確認しましょう。
explain.en: In Figure 2-1 White is planning △6四歩 to attack the bishop. If Black answered by retreating with ▲8八角, the bishop would no longer reach the edge and the edge attack would fail. So Black first plays ▲5六歩, so that △6四歩 can be met by ▲5七角. See the supplement for what goes wrong without ▲5六歩.

section.ja: 角の逃げ道を作る▲5六歩
section.en: ▲5六歩 to create an escape route for the bishop

title.ja: 図a-1 ▲5六歩と突かずに攻めた場合
title.en: Figure a-1: If attacking without pushing ▲5六歩

explain.ja: 図2-1から▲5六歩を突かず、いきなり▲9四歩と攻めた場合を考えます。△同歩、▲同香と進めば下手が良さそうに見えますが、実際はどうでしょうか。
explain.en: Consider attacking at once with ▲9四歩 from Figure 2-1 without playing ▲5六歩. After △同歩, ▲同香 it seems Black is doing well, but is that really so?

section.ja: 角の逃げ道を作る▲5六歩
section.en: ▲5六歩 to create an escape route for the bishop

title.ja: 図a-2 香車が走った瞬間に△6四歩
title.en: Figure a-2: △6四歩 the moment the lance runs

explain.ja: 図a-1からは、△同歩、▲同香と香車を走らせた瞬間に△6四歩と角を攻撃されます。そこで下手が角を逃がすとどうなるか、もう少し見てみましょう。
explain.en: From Figure a-1, the moment Black runs the lance with △同歩, ▲同香, White attacks the bishop with △6四歩. Let us see what happens if Black then moves the bishop away.

section.ja: 角の逃げ道を作る▲5六歩
section.en: ▲5六歩 to create an escape route for the bishop

title.ja: 図a-3 香車が死んでしまう
title.en: Figure a-3: The lance is trapped

explain.ja: 図a-2から▲8八角などと角を逃がすと、△9三歩と打たれて香車を取られてしまいます。香車が後ろに下がれないという弱点を突かれた形です。
explain.en: If Black retreats the bishop with ▲8八角 from Figure a-2, White drops △9三歩 and the lance is lost. White exploits the lance's weakness that it cannot move backward.

section.ja: 角の逃げ道を作る▲5六歩
section.en: ▲5六歩 to create an escape route for the bishop

explain.ja: 図2-2から下手はいよいよ端攻めを始め、まず▲9四歩と突きます。9三の地点には角と香車の2枚が利いているのに対し、上手は銀1枚しか利いていないので、数の攻めが成立します。
explain.en: From Figure 2-2 Black finally begins the edge attack, starting with ▲9四歩. Two Black pieces, the bishop and the lance, bear on 9三 while White has only a silver defending it, so Black has the numbers for the attack.

section.en: The weaker side starts the attack

title.ja: 図3-2 一見タダの歩だが…？
title.en: Figure 3-2: Looks like a free pawn, but...?

explain.ja: 下手は順調に端攻めを進めますが、上手が△8四歩と突いてきました。この歩にどんな狙いがあるか考えましょう。角でタダ取りできるように見えますが、すぐ取らず相手の狙いをよく考えるべきです。▲同角と取るとどうなるかは補足で確認します。
explain.en: Black keeps pressing the edge attack, but White plays △8四歩. Think about what this pawn is aiming at. The bishop could take it for free, but do not grab it immediately; consider White's intention first. The supplement shows what happens after ▲同角.

section.en: What is the meaning of the stronger side's △8四歩?

title.ja: 図b-1 △8四歩に対して▲同角と取る
title.en: Figure b-1: Capture with ▲同角 against △8四歩

explain.ja: 図3-2から▲同角と歩を取った場合を見ます。一見、歩をタダで取れたうえ次の端攻めも厳しく、下手優勢に見えます。
explain.en: Look at the line where Black captures with ▲同角 from Figure 3-2. At first sight Black has won a pawn for free and the next edge attack looks severe, so Black seems better.

section.en: What is the meaning of the stronger side's △8四歩?

title.en: Figure b-2: Fork on bishop and lance

explain.ja: しかし図b-1から△8四金と上がられると、角と香車の両取りになってしまいます。これでは下手が指しにくいでしょう。
explain.en: However, from Figure b-1 White plays △8四金, forking the bishop and the lance. That leaves Black in an awkward position.

section.en: What is the meaning of the stronger side's △8四歩?

title.ja: 図3-3 飛車も端攻めに参加
title.en: Figure 3-3: The rook joins the edge attack too

explain.ja: 図3-2からは▲9二香成と香車を成って攻めます。さらに▲9八飛として、9筋に攻め駒を次々と投入していきます。
explain.en: From Figure 3-2 Black promotes the lance with ▲9二香成, then plays ▲9八飛 to bring more attacking pieces onto the 9th file.

section.ja: 飛車も使ってさらに9筋を攻める
section.en: Use the rook too and attack the ninth file further

title.ja: 図3-4 さらに攻め駒を足すには？
title.en: Figure 3-4: How to add more attacking pieces?

explain.ja: 下手は見事に飛車を成り込むことに成功しました。ただし図3-4では上手の陣形も堅く、簡単には玉を攻められません。ここから攻め駒を増やしたいところですが、持ち駒は歩しかない中、どの駒を攻めに使うかが問題です。
explain.en: Black succeeded in promoting the rook. In Figure 3-4, however, White's formation is solid and the king cannot be attacked easily. Black wants more attacking pieces, but with only pawns in hand, the question is which piece to use for the attack.

section.ja: 飛車も使ってさらに9筋を攻める
section.en: Use the rook too and attack the ninth file further

line.text: △4二銀、▲8一成香、△5三歩、▲9二飛成、△6三玉

title.ja: 図3-5 次に確実にと金を作れる
title.en: Figure 3-5: Next a tokin is guaranteed

explain.ja: 図3-4からは▲9四歩が良い手です。次の▲9三歩成を上手は受けられず、と金を作って攻められます。このように次に歩成を狙う歩打ちを「垂れ歩」といい、歩の重要な手筋の一つです。垂れ歩からと金を作り、と金と相手の金や銀との交換を狙いましょう。具体的には図3-5から▲9三歩成、▲8三となどを狙います。
explain.en: From Figure 3-4, ▲9四歩 is the good move. White cannot stop ▲9三歩成 next, so Black gets a tokin to attack with. A pawn drop that threatens to promote next is called a dangling pawn, one of the key pawn tesuji. Make a tokin from a dangling pawn and aim to trade it for White's gold or silver; concretely, from Figure 3-5 aim for ▲9三歩成 followed by ▲8三と.

section.ja: 垂れ歩の手筋でと金を作る
section.en: Make a tokin with the dangling pawn tesuji

title.ja: 図4-1 上手の金上がりの意味は？
title.en: Figure 4-1: What does the upper player's gold move mean?

explain.ja: 図2-2まで戻り、上手の別の手を見ます。今度は上手が金を上げてきました。この手にはどんな意味があるのでしょうか。
explain.en: Return to Figure 2-2 and look at a different White move. This time White advances the gold. What is the point of this move?

section.en: Defending with the stronger side's △8四金

explain.ja: 上手の狙いは△8四金と上がることでした。下手は香車が取られそうなので▲9二香成と成り込みたいところですが、それでよいのでしょうか。
explain.en: White's aim was to play △8四金. Black's lance is about to be captured, so Black would like to promote with ▲9二香成, but is that really right?

section.en: Defending with the stronger side's △8四金

title.ja: 図4-3 飛車が走れなくなる

explain.ja: 先ほどと同じく▲9八飛として飛車を攻めに参加させようとしましたが、今度は△9五歩で防がれてしまい、下手は攻めにくくなりました。上手が△8四金と上がる形には、別の攻め方をした方がよかったようです。手が少し変わるだけで局面は大きく変わります。△8四金型への上手な指し方は、所司和晴著『【決定版】駒落ち定跡』に詳しく載っています。実戦では9筋を攻めた後も対局は続き、龍やと金ができたら玉を攻める段階に入ります。うまい攻めには詰みの形を多く知るのが良く、1手詰の問題から始めるのがお勧めです。
explain.en: As before, Black tries to bring the rook into the attack with ▲9八飛, but this time White blocks it with △9五歩, and Black has trouble continuing. Against the setup where White plays △8四金, a different attack would have been better. A small change in moves changes the position a lot. The book "Definitive Handicap Joseki" by Kazuharu Shoji covers the △8四金 setup in detail. In a real game play goes on after the 9th-file attack, and once you have a dragon or tokin you start attacking the king. To attack well, learn many mating patterns, starting with one-move checkmate problems.

section.ja: 飛車先突破を防がれる
